title: VIGIA verdict stream entry
description: One sealed verdict in the live hash chain. Produced by the deterministic core after scoring one evidence window; consumed by the dashboard, CRONOS, and the replay verifier. The entry_hash is the SHA-256 of the canonical serialization of this document with the entry_hash field absent. Tamper evidence: entry N commits to entry N-1 via prev_entry_hash; genesis entries use 64 zeros.

sequence.description: Must equal the sequence of the evidence window it adjudicates.

window_hash.description: window_hash of the evidence window this verdict is sealed over.

prev_entry_hash.description: entry_hash of the previous stream entry; 64 zeros for sequence 0.

score.description: Exact fraction num/den. Never a float.

confidence.description: Exact fraction num/den. Never a float.

determinism_level.description: Honest guarantee level. Partial evidence never silently claims 'sealed' strength; a window scored under degradation says so here.

bundle_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full sealed verdict bundle (stored beside the stream, verifiable independently).

bundle_ref.description: Optional locator (path/URL) of the full bundle. Never trusted without checking bundle_sha256.

narrative_ref.description: Optional locator of the LLM narrative. Stored BESIDE the seal, never inside it; absent narrative never degrades the verdict.
